Priya (CSM): Heads up — Solstice (Enterprise) is burning ~3x our forecasted tokens this week, renewal in ~30 days. Can we get a short runway forecast + an enablement checklist we can run before renewal? :warning:

Leo (FinOps): On it. Can you drop the last 7d usage and their plan so I can run a burn-rate sim? Also need the PM contact.

Priya (CSM): Copy. Last 7d: 2.4M tokens/day avg, spike to 7.1M on Tue after a new chatflow launch. Plan: Dedicated L (reserved) expecting ~1.2M/day. PM: @Jared. I'll DM logs and the spike trace.

Ana (Onboarding): If the new chatflow is unbatched, that's the usual culprit. We have a quick checklist: `reduce_streaming_window: true`, `batch_size: 32`, `enable_prefix_cache: true`. Want me to run a 30-min enablement with them? :calendar:

Jared (AE): They're open to a short session tomorrow morning. Commercial note: if we can't show cost-down opportunities, they may push on commit size at renewal.

Leo (FinOps): Quick sim idea: trimming prompts + batching could reduce tokens/session ~25% => ~22% monthly spend savings. I'll run two scenarios and upload numbers (baseline vs trim+batching).

Ruth (Solutions): I'll own the technical runbook for the session. Proposed checklist: 1) session-level prompt truncation, 2) enable KV/prefix caching, 3) TTL policies for embeddings, 4) use quantized smaller model for non-critical flows. I'll prepare 6-8 slide deck items and a 12-item eval set.

Priya (CSM): Also need a safe rollback policy if the quantized model shows quality regressions — customer cares about fidelity.

Ruth (Solutions): Recommend canary rollout: `canary_percent: 5`, `monitor: ["response_quality_delta", "latency_p99", "error_rate"]` and an auto-fallback to baseline after X failing checks. I'll attach the eval prompt set.

billing-bot: Alert: Solstice usage threshold exceeded forecast x10; ticket #5238 created.

Leo (FinOps): Noted ticket #5238. I'm generating two CSVs: `baseline.csv` and `trim_batching_scenario.csv`. Will post to drive: https://drive.redwood/workspaces/solstice/cost-sims (sharing perms set to Solstice PM).

Priya (CSM): Scheduled the enablement session: 2026-04-02 10:00 PT. Agenda in doc (enablement, quick sims, action items). I'll capture feedback and set renewal risk to 'medium' pre-session.

Jared (AE): I'll prepare commercial options: increase reserved capacity vs hybrid burst. Need cost-delta table for both options.

Ana (Onboarding): I'll demo the Console knobs: batching, KV cache toggle, and prompt templates. Quick checklist I'm sending now via DM: `['confirm model variant', 'enable KV cache', 'apply prompt templates', 'set burst limits', 'monitor tokens-per-session']`.

Priya (CSM): Post-session action items: 1) update customer playbook with chosen knobs, 2) email exec summary with savings scenarios, 3) schedule 2-week check-in. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Ruth (Solutions): I'll also capture customer feedback items into the product backlog card and tag @product for any feature gaps (e.g., console-presets for trimmed prompts).

Leo (FinOps): I'll drop the forecast CSVs and an executive one-pager into the doc before EOD so AE can include numbers in renewal convo.

Priya (CSM): Great — aim to reduce renewal risk by demonstrating >=15% predictable cost improvement and an ops play we can run. I'll follow up after the session with notes and update the renewal flag.
